summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight, igniting fires in three districts including a high-rise building. A major Russian armored assault near Shakhtove involving two armies and a tank division was repelled with heavy losses claimed by Ukrainian forces. Ukrainian long-range drones attacked Russian military assets in the Caspian Sea, hitting an oil platform, two sanctioned vessels, and a missile boat.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv causing fires in Shevchenkivskyi, Darnytskyi, and Dniprovskyi districts with debris striking an 18-story building. (Source: @UkraineNow/82936)

Ukrainian forces destroyed 7 tanks, 6 APCs, a Tornado-S and Grad launcher, 3 engineering vehicles, 47 light vehicles, killed 123 and wounded 29 Russian troops repelling a large armored assault near Shakhtove. (Source: @eRadarrua/102728)
Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Filanovsky oil platform, cargo ship Port Olya 2, dry cargo Begey, and a Project 12418 Molniya missile boat in the Caspian Sea. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)
Russian forces claimed liberation of Shevchenko settlement in the DNR. (Source: @tass_agency/387157)
Russian strikes hit a UAV assembly and storage facility in Kyiv allegedly producing up to 1,000 drones monthly with US specialists. (Source: @tass_agency/387144)
Russian Ministry of Defense reported striking Ukrainian logistics centers, long-range UAV production workshops and storage facilities over the past day. (Source: @tass_agency/387159)
Over 16,000 Ukrainian civilians are considered missing, some possibly in Russian captivity, per Ombudsman Lubinets. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31926)
Soldiers of the 108th Territorial Defense Brigade appealed over lack of rotation for over six months, reporting severe weight loss and exhaustion. (Source: @UkraineNow/82931)

sections.executive_summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight, igniting fires in three districts including a high-rise building. A major Russian armored assault near Shakhtove involving two armies and a tank division was repelled with heavy losses claimed by Ukrainian forces. Ukrainian long-range drones attacked Russian military assets in the Caspian Sea, hitting an oil platform, two sanctioned vessels, and a missile boat.

points: Ukrainian long-range drones conducted a coordinated strike on Russian military infrastructure in the Caspian Sea, destroying the Filanovsky oil platform, two sanctioned cargo vessels (Port Olya 2 and Begey) used for Iran-Russia military shipments, and a Project 12418 Molniya missile boat. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)

Ukrainian forces reportedly attacked tourist bases in Kirillovka, Zaporizhzhia region, with 25 FP-2 type drones, killing 8-15 civilians including children per Russian-installed officials, while mobile fire units claimed 17 drones shot down. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31919, @ukr_leaks_eng/31915)

The 108th Territorial Defense Brigade soldiers publicly appealed over a six-month rotation freeze, describing extreme physical deterioration with soldiers losing half their body weight and resembling Holodomor victims, citing the security situation as the main obstacle. (Source: @UkraineNow/82931)

Ukrainian drone activity targeted Russian territory, with a fire spreading from a private house to the Madam shopping center in Ramenskoye, Moscow region, causing fireworks explosions audible across the city. (Source: @eRadarrua/102731)
Ombudsman Lubinets reported over 16,000 Ukrainian civilians missing since the invasion, with some potentially held in Russian captivity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31926)

Protests against the dismissal of former Defense Minister Fedorov continued for a tenth consecutive day across major Ukrainian cities including Kyiv, Lviv, Kharkiv, and Odesa. (Source: @tass_agency/387130)

Russian forces launched ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, causing fires in three districts (Shevchenkivskyi, Darnytskyi, Dniprovskyi) with debris igniting a 4-story abandoned building and an 18-story residential building. (Source: @UkraineNow/82936)

A large-scale Russian armored assault near Shakhtove (Donetsk) involving the 8th and 41st Combined Arms Armies and the 90th Tank Division was halted after four hours by Azov National Guard, SBU Center for Special Operations 'A', and Ukrainian Air Force, with claimed losses of 7 tanks, 6 APCs, 2 MLRS launchers, 3 engineering vehicles, 47 light vehicles, 123 killed and 29 wounded. (Source: @eRadarrua/102728)
Russian Ministry of Defense announced the liberation of Shevchenko settlement in the DNR. (Source: @tass_agency/387157)
Russian strikes targeted a UAV assembly and storage facility in Kyiv where up to 1,000 drones were allegedly produced monthly with involvement of US specialists. (Source: @tass_agency/387144)
Russian forces struck Ukrainian logistics centers, long-range UAV production workshops and storage facilities over the past 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/387159)

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed Ukrainian losses of approximately 1,345 personnel across all fronts in the past day, along with strikes on fuel-energy and transport infrastructure used by Ukrainian forces. (Source: @tass_agency/387160)

Russian naval forces have formed drone regiments, continue operating Borei-class submarines with Bulava missiles, possess Poseidon carriers, and are finalizing tests of the modernized Admiral Nakhimov battlecruiser, while Black Sea Fleet submarines participate in strikes on Ukraine. (Source: @tass_agency/387155)
Russian forces advanced near Mali Prokhody and Kalenyky in the Donetsk sector per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23683)
The major Russian armored assault near Shakhtove involving the 8th and 41st Armies and 90th Tank Division was repelled with heavy equipment losses. (Source: @eRadarrua/102728)
Russian forces claimed liberation of Shevchenko settlement in the DNR. (Source: @tass_agency/387157)
In the Kupyansk sector, Russian forces are repelling Ukrainian attacks in the western part of the city while increasing presence in urban areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31928)
Russian forces advanced in the Konstantinovka direction and liberated Belitskoye in the Dobropillia sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31928)
Enemy actions in the Krasny Liman area were thwarted. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31928)

Multiple Shahed-type drones detected over Chernihiv region heading toward Kyiv region (Zhurivka/Berezany), with air raid alerts in Kyiv at 02:49 and all-clear at 01:12 on July 26. (Source: @eRadarrua/102742, @kpszsu/70147, @eRadarrua/102713, @eRadarrua/102710)
Guided drones operated near Horodnia and Nizhyn in Chernihiv region, with reconnaissance drones from Ripky. (Source: @eRadarrua/102761, @eRadarrua/102762)
Strike UAVs moved through eastern Sumy region on a southern course toward Poltava region. (Source: @kpszsu/70111)
Jet-powered UAVs observed in Poltava region past Karlivka heading southwest. (Source: @kpszsu/70136)
Shahed drones approached Slavutych heading toward Vyshhorod/Kyiv region and Brovary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69396, @mon1tor_ua/69406)
Ballistic missile threat alert issued and later cleared for Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/70164)
Russian KAB guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia region in the direction of the regional center. (Source: @kpszsu/70166)

Ukrainian drone attack on Kirillovka tourist bases in Zaporizhzhia region killed 8-15 civilians including children per Russian-installed administration. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31919, @ukr_leaks_eng/31915)
A terminal in Ukrainian-controlled Zaporizhzhia burned after a Russian strike. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31927)
Jet-powered UAV from Black Sea headed toward southern Odesa region (Vylkove). (Source: @kpszsu/70142)
Russian strikes intensified on port infrastructure and merchant ships in Odesa and Mykolaiv directions, demonstrated twice daily per Russian MoD publications. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31928)
Zaporizhzhia front and Kherson direction remain unchanged per Russian milblogger assessment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31928)
Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv overnight causing fires in three districts. (Source: @UkraineNow/82936)

Shahed-type drones active across northern and central Ukraine: Chernihiv, Kyiv, Sumy, Poltava regions with multiple air raid alerts. (Source: @eRadarrua/102742, @kpszsu/70147, @kpszsu/70111, @kpszsu/70136, @mon1tor_ua/69396, @mon1tor_ua/69406)
Ukrainian long-range drones hit Russian military targets in Caspian Sea: oil platform, two sanctioned vessels, missile boat. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)
Ukrainian FP-2 type drones attacked Kirillovka in Zaporizhzhia region, 17 reportedly shot down by mobile fire units. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31915)
Russian KAB guided bombs used on Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/70166)
Russian strikes hit UAV production facility in Kyiv and logistics centers/UAV workshops across Ukraine. (Source: @tass_agency/387144, @tass_agency/387159)
Jet-powered UAVs (likely reconnaissance/strike) operating from Black Sea toward Odesa region and across central Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/70142, @kpszsu/70136)

key_developments: Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv ignited fires in three districts including an 18-story residential building, marking a significant escalation in strikes on the capital. (Source: @UkraineNow/82936)

Ukrainian forces repelled a major Russian armored assault near Shakhtove involving two combined arms armies and a tank division, claiming destruction of 7 tanks, 6 APCs, 2 MLRS launchers, and 123 Russian personnel killed. (Source: @eRadarrua/102728)

Ukrainian long-range drones struck strategic Russian assets in the Caspian Sea including the Filanovsky oil platform, two Iran-Russia sanctions-busting cargo vessels, and a Molniya-class missile boat. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)

Russian forces claimed liberation of Shevchenko in the DNR while DeepState maps confirm Russian advances near Mali Prokhody and Kalenyky in Donetsk sector. (Source: @tass_agency/387157, @DeepStateUA/23683)

Russian strikes destroyed a Kyiv UAV facility allegedly producing 1,000 drones monthly with US specialists, and hit logistics centers and long-range UAV workshops nationwide. (Source: @tass_agency/387144, @tass_agency/387159)

Over 16,000 Ukrainian civilians remain missing per Ombudsman Lubinets, while 108th Brigade soldiers report catastrophic physical condition after six months without rotation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31926, @UkraineNow/82931)

Russian naval doctrine now includes formed drone regiments, Poseidon carriers, and Black Sea Fleet submarine strikes on Ukraine, while Ukrainian naval drones only target civilian ships per Russian Navy chief. (Source: @tass_agency/387155)
sections.threat_assessment: The conflict is escalating with Russia employing ballistic missiles against Kyiv's civilian infrastructure while simultaneously launching large-scale combined arms offensives in Donetsk that are being repulsed at high cost. Ukraine's asymmetric response demonstrates growing long-range strike capability against strategic Russian energy and naval assets deep in rear areas, including the Caspian Sea. The front lines continue a slow westward creep in the east, but the air war has expanded significantly with mass drone operations across northern, central, and southern Ukraine. Russian strikes on Ukrainian drone production and logistics indicate a systematic effort to degrade Ukraine's asymmetric advantages, while Ukraine's attacks on Russian rear logistics and energy infrastructure aim to impose economic costs. The humanitarian situation deteriorates with over 16,000 missing civilians and frontline units suffering severe exhaustion without rotation.
sections.regional_response: Kazakh President Tokayev publicly questioned the war's rationale to Putin's face in Omsk, urging a freeze and referencing the Istanbul formula, signaling Central Asian discomfort with the conflict's trajectory. Italy's Defense Minister Crosetto offered dismissed Ukrainian Defense Minister Fedorov an advisory role, reflecting continued European political engagement with Ukrainian leadership figures. Protests in Ukraine over Fedorov's dismissal persist across ten major cities for a tenth day, indicating domestic political turbulence. The Trump administration warned Ukraine against attacking non-Russian shipping after Ukrainian naval drones hit a Chevron-chartered tanker near Novorossiysk, revealing Western commercial pressure on Ukrainian targeting decisions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported destruction of a Tornado-S and Grad MLRS launcher near Shakhtove suggests Ukrainian precision targeting of Russian artillery enablers during the assault. The Caspian Sea strikes demonstrate Ukrainian drone range exceeding 1,000km, threatening Russian energy exports and Iranian supply lines simultaneously. Russian claims of 1,345 Ukrainian casualties in a single day, if accurate, indicate intense attrition across multiple sectors. The 108th Brigade's public appeal reveals systemic manpower management failures that could affect defensive cohesion. Russian naval modernization including drone regiments and Poseidon deployment signals a long-term strategic posture shift toward unmanned and nuclear-capable maritime systems. The Wildberries logistics center targeting reflects a Russian strategy to disrupt Ukrainian domestic commerce and Western e-commerce revenue streams.
